recipe.name: lumen-blocks host rules tests
recipe.notes: Android app — full gradle build needs the Android SDK/NDK + android-37 platform (preview), not available on this host. The recipe verifies the pure C++ game rules (game_rules.h) which compile and run anywhere with a C++17 toolchain. Native Renderer.cpp was additionally compile-verified against the NDK 29 sysroot + games-activity 4.0.0 prefab headers with -Werror (0 diagnostics).
